title: Farm Tiles Harvest
description: Experience top-rated farm-themed tile matching in Farm Tile Harvest! Draw up to 9 tiles featuring fruits, veggies, and tools in a quaint countryside setting. Match three identical tiles to clear them and avoid ending the game by drawing the 9th tile. Shuffle to reveal hidden tiles and race against the clock. Harvest all the crops! Play Farm Tile Harvest on lofgames.com.
instructions: Use a mouse or touch-pad to play this game
